description:
Pinterest Scraper — Search, Boards & Profiles

Scrape Pinterest pins from keyword search, boards and profiles. Full-res originals, video variants, board/pinner metadata, repin counts. Pure HTTP - no browser, no login, no API key, no proxy.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Pin scraped: $0.00199; Media downloaded: $0.005; platform usage billed to your account.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/pinterest-scraper.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

boardIds.description: Comma-separated numeric board ids, e.g. `286612032474627954`. Faster than boardUrls (skips the id-resolution request). Used when mode=board.
boardIds.title: Board IDs

boardUrls.description: Comma-separated board URLs or paths, e.g. `https://www.pinterest.com/les_bons_details/interior-design/` or `/les_bons_details/interior-design/`. The numeric board id is resolved automatically from the board page. Used when mode=board.
boardUrls.title: Board URLs

downloadMedia.description: Download each pin's image (or MP4 for video pins) into the run's key-value store and link it from the dataset row. Billed per file downloaded. Off by default — the image URLs in the dataset are directly usable.
downloadMedia.title: Download media files

enrichDetails.description: Fetch each pin's detail endpoint for extra fields. Costs one extra HTTP request per pin, so runs take noticeably longer. Worth it in search mode; usually redundant in board/profile mode, where pins already arrive with full metadata. Without a login, the detail endpoint returns a reduced field set (SEO title/description, creator) — not the complete pin record.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich pin details

imageSize.description: Which image variant to put in `imageUrl` (and to download when media download is on). `orig` is the full-resolution original.
imageSize.title: Image size

includeRaw.description: Keep the untouched Pinterest pin object in the `raw` column. Turn off for smaller datasets.
includeRaw.title: Include raw payload

maxPinsPerSource.description: Maximum pins to collect per query / board / profile. This is your cost ceiling: pins scraped × the per-pin price. Hard cap: 5000.
maxPinsPerSource.title: Max pins per source

maxPinsTotal.description: Optional global cap across EVERY query / board / profile in the run, on top of max pins per source. Leave empty for no global cap (unlimited). Use this to keep long multi-source runs inside the 1-hour platform timeout.
maxPinsTotal.title: Max pins total (all sources combined)

mode.description: search = keyword search (use queries). board = every pin on a board (use boardUrls or boardIds). profile = every pin a user has published (use usernames).
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Not required — Pinterest's resource API responds normally to datacenter IPs. Kept as an escape hatch in case an exit IP gets throttled.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

queries.description: Comma-separated search keywords, e.g. `ai wallpaper, minimal interior`. Required when mode=search — leave empty to use the default query `ai wallpaper`. NOTE: Pinterest's search payload contains images only — no title, description, board or pinner. Turn on "Enrich pin details" if you need those fields.
queries.title: Search queries

usernames.description: Comma-separated Pinterest usernames, e.g. `ohuhu, nasa`. A leading @ and full profile URLs are accepted. Required when mode=profile.
usernames.title: Profile usernames

name: pinterest
